<?php
/**
 * gRPC Template Rendering Service
 * Handles template rendering requests from upstream reverse proxy
 * Protocol: gRPC with JSON-encoded payloads via envoy transcoding
 */

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Grpc\RpcServer;
use Google\Protobuf\Internal\Message;

class TemplateContext {
    private array $variables = [];
    private array $allowedFunctions = ['date', 'strtoupper', 'strtolower', 'number_format'];
    
    public function set(string $key, $value): void {
        $this->variables[$key] = $value;
    }
    
    public function get(string $key) {
        return $this->variables[$key] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function getAllowedFunctions(): array {
        return $this->allowedFunctions;
    }
}

class TemplateSandbox {
    private TemplateContext $context;
    private string $cacheDir;
    
    public function __construct(TemplateContext $context) {
        $this->context = $context;
        $this->cacheDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/tpl_cache';
        if (!is_dir($this->cacheDir)) {
            mkdir($this->cacheDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Compiles template expressions into safe PHP.
     * Expression syntax: {{ variable }} or {{ func(variable) }}
     */
    public function compile(string $template): string {
        // Phase 1: Strip dangerous constructs
        $sanitized = $this->stripDangerous($template);
        
        // Phase 2: Compile expressions
        $compiled = $this->compileExpressions($sanitized);
        
        return $compiled;
    }
    
    private function stripDangerous(string $input): string {
        // Remove PHP tags
        $input = preg_replace('/<\?(?:php)?/i', '', $input);
        $input = preg_replace('/\?>/', '', $input);
        
        // Remove backticks (shell execution)
        $input = str_replace('`', '', $input);
        
        // Block dangerous function patterns
        $blocked = ['eval', 'exec', 'system', 'passthru', 'shell_exec',
                    'popen', 'proc_open', 'pcntl_exec', 'assert',
                    'preg_replace', 'create_function', 'call_user_func',
                    'file_put_contents', 'file_get_contents', 'fwrite',
                    'include', 'require', 'unserialize'];
        
        foreach ($blocked as $func) {
            // Case-insensitive function call blocking
            $input = preg_replace('/\b' . preg_quote($func) . '\s*\(/i', 'BLOCKED(', $input);
        }
        
        return $input;
    }
    
    private function compileExpressions(string $template): string {
        // Match {{ expression }} patterns
        return preg_replace_callback('/\{\{\s*(.+?)\s*\}\}/', function($matches) {
            $expr = $matches[1];
            return $this->evaluateExpression($expr);
        }, $template);
    }
    
    private function evaluateExpression(string $expr): string {
        // Simple variable reference: {{ name }}
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/', $expr)) {
            $val = $this->context->get($expr);
            return htmlspecialchars((string)$val, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        }
        
        // Function call: {{ func(arg) }}
        if (preg_match('/^([a-zA-Z_]+)\((.*)\)$/', $expr, $m)) {
            $func = $m[1];
            $arg = trim($m[2]);
            
            if (in_array($func, $this->context->getAllowedFunctions())) {
                $argVal = $this->context->get($arg) ?? $arg;
                $result = call_user_func($func, $argVal);
                return htmlspecialchars((string)$result, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            }
            return '[blocked function]';
        }
        
        // Pipe syntax: {{ variable | filter }}
        if (preg_match('/^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\|\s*([a-zA-Z_]+)$/', $expr, $m)) {
            $varName = $m[1];
            $filter = $m[2];
            $val = $this->context->get($varName);
            return $this->applyFilter($val, $filter);
        }
        
        return '[invalid expression]';
    }
    
    private function applyFilter($value, string $filter): string {
        $filters = [
            'upper' => 'strtoupper',
            'lower' => 'strtolower', 
            'trim' => 'trim',
            'length' => 'strlen',
            'raw' => null,  // No escaping
        ];
        
        if (!array_key_exists($filter, $filters)) {
            return htmlspecialchars((string)$value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        }
        
        if ($filter === 'raw') {
            return (string)$value;
        }
        
        $result = call_user_func($filters[$filter], $value);
        return htmlspecialchars((string)$result, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }
}

class RenderService {
    /**
     * Handles gRPC RenderTemplate requests.
     * The reverse proxy (envoy) transcodes HTTP/JSON to gRPC.
     * Request fields: template_body, context_vars (JSON object), cache_key
     */
    public function RenderTemplate(object $request): array {
        $templateBody = $request->template_body ?? '';
        $contextVars = json_decode($request->context_vars ?? '{}', true) ?: [];
        $cacheKey = $request->cache_key ?? null;
        
        $ctx = new TemplateContext();
        foreach ($contextVars as $k => $v) {
            if (is_string($k) && preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/', $k)) {
                $ctx->set($k, $v);
            }
        }
        
        $sandbox = new TemplateSandbox($ctx);
        
        // Compile and render
        $output = $sandbox->compile($templateBody);
        
        // Cache compiled output if cache_key provided
        if ($cacheKey && preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $cacheKey)) {
            $this->cacheResult($cacheKey, $output);
        }
        
        return ['rendered_output' => $output, 'status' => 'OK'];
    }
    
    private function cacheResult(string $key, string $content): void {
        $cacheDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/tpl_cache';
        $path = $cacheDir . '/' . $key . '.html';
        file_put_contents($path, $content);
    }
}

// gRPC server bootstrap
$server = new RenderService();

// Simulate incoming gRPC request (in production, this comes from grpc-php extension)
$input = file_get_contents('php://input');
$decoded = json_decode($input);

if ($decoded) {
    $result = $server->RenderTemplate($decoded);
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($result);
}
